verdict.rationale: Adyen has no general automation or background-agent builder, but it does document configurable behaviors that run without manual action. Merchants can set payout frequency per merchant account (adyen-docs-12). They can build custom risk rules that automatically block, allow, or review each payment (adyen-docs-20, adyen-docs-48). Webhooks push asynchronous status changes so you don't have to poll (adyen-docs-3), and the MCP server can schedule terminal actions (adyen-supp-mcp-tools). Missing for 10: a general-purpose workflow or automation builder, autonomous agent jobs triggered by events or schedules, AI-driven background task orchestration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
